evals.name: new-instagram-post-design
evals.prompt: 우리 카페 신메뉴(딸기라떼) 홍보용 인스타그램 게시물 캔바로 하나 만들어줘. 핑크톤으로, '신메뉴 출시'라는 문구 넣어서.
evals.expected_output: Calls generate-design with a brief built from the stated purpose (Instagram post), color (pink tones), and copy ('신메뉴 출시'), presents the returned candidates to the user for selection rather than auto-picking one, and only calls create-design-from-candidate after the user chooses (or explicitly says to auto-pick).
assertions: the brief passed to generate-design reflects Instagram post format, pink color tone, and the '신메뉴 출시' text
response presents multiple candidates to the user and asks them to pick, rather than silently calling create-design-from-candidate for an auto-chosen candidate
response does not invent brand details (e.g. a logo, tagline, or price) that the user did not mention

evals.name: edit-existing-design-headline
evals.prompt: 지난주에 만든 '가을 세일' 포스터 있잖아, 거기 제목을 '가을맞이 특가전'으로 바꿔줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses search-designs to locate the '가을 세일' design, opens an editing transaction, changes the headline text via perform-editing-operations, and commits the transaction. Summarizes the change before or after committing.
assertions: search-designs is called with a keyword derived from '가을 세일'
commit-editing-transaction is called (edit is not left uncommitted)
the edit changes only the headline text to '가을맞이 특가전', not unrelated design elements
if search-designs returns no match, the skill asks the user to describe the design differently instead of silently creating a new design or reporting failure with no next step

evals.name: export-format-not-specified
evals.expected_output: Since the export format wasn't specified for a presentation design, the skill asks which format the user wants (e.g. PDF vs PPTX vs PNG per-slide) rather than silently defaulting, then calls export-design once the format is known.
assertions: response asks the user for the desired export format before calling export-design
response does not silently default to a format without confirming
once a format is given (in a follow-up), export-design is called with that format
response shares the resulting file/link with the user rather than only confirming success
